claim.statement: Current OpenCode sharing documentation says session sharing can be manual, automatic or disabled; creating a share synchronizes the session history to OpenCode servers and produces a public link, while unsharing removes the shared data.

source.title: OpenCode Share
source.locator: How sharing works; manual, auto and disabled modes; unshare

limitations: The catalog did not create a share, inspect uploaded content, test access controls or verify deletion; the claim is publisher-attributed.
unknowns: The effective sharing mode, whether any session was shared, the synchronized content, link audience, retention, deletion behavior and jurisdiction are unknown.
